name: Initial Prep — Window Jamb (Prime)
intent: Dust/wipe, fill fasteners, sand bare jamb before prime coat. Caulk happens post-prime in MOD_PREP_WINDOW_JAMB_PAINT (caulk does not bond to bare wood). Fill end grain retired — jamb stock has factory-finished ends.
doctrine: 1:1 mirror of MOD_PREP_TRIM_INITIAL with substrate-specific tasks for jamb. Rate-matched to trim prime per user direction.
